sampling_rule: One NumPy default_rng(seed).choice(ascending eligible IDs excluding the verified showcase, size=(6,30), replace=False); preserve draw order; no replacement across the six groups.
common_hours_rule: Intersect complete finite household hours within each group; same observed common hours and cap for both battery options; no imputation; split at gaps with existing full-SOC segment boundaries.
load_basis: Measured, unshifted hourly AMI; synthetic neighborhoods, not feeder mapping.
storage_rules: Existing model: 20% reserve, symmetric sqrt(0.894) efficiency, home no-export, 0-2 modules per home, full SOC at each complete segment boundary; shared 5 kWh / 2.5 kW increments.
costs: Assumed: homes $8,500/module + $3,000/site; shared $15,000 + $650/kWh at modeled power.
outcome_rule: Count strict wins only when a feasible upper cost is below the other option's certified lower bound; ties require both cost intervals to collapse to the same value. Otherwise unresolved. Include all six groups and all timeouts.
fallback: If fewer than four comparisons are certified, lead with showcase installed-cost sensitivity: shared $50,750 vs homes $60,000; +$9,250 shared installed cost erases the advantage, all else equal.
